summary.text: Ed Neilson is a Democratic state representative who has represented Pennsylvania House of Representatives District 174 since August 25, 2015 and is on the ballot for re-election on November 3, 2026.
He previously served in the House for District 169 and on the Philadelphia City Council.

paragraphs.text: Ed Neilson's Ballotpedia profile lists earlier service as a member of the Pennsylvania House of Representatives for District 169 from 2012 to 2014 and as an at-large member of the Philadelphia City Council from 2014 to 2015.
He assumed office as the District 174 representative in August 2015.
In the 2023-2024 session he chaired the House Transportation Committee, and in 2021-2022 he was Democratic chair of the Game and Fisheries Committee.
